title: Exclude direct deletion of paid P104 owned MOVEs (0% κ change)
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

**NO VERIFIED GAIN. Exact conditional κ change 0%.** All 47 paid owned MOVEs on the exact #7277 P104 word have a nonzero arbitrary-input rational row. None has CLEAR as its next contact in the same lifetime. The two direct deletion predicates exhaust their fixed-word scopes, leaving zero unresolved. The optimistic compatible whole-word saving is exactly zero.

## Task and overlap

Canonical base e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57. This package refines the P104 side-correction task by checking the current literal word. #6865 proves an earlier #6833 owned-exit floor. #7165 tests donor routes on #7161. #7001 removes empty-root accounting credits on BIT while keeping the native calls. This package tests literal zero-input and direct CLEAR predicates on #7277. The two inherited #7257 CI commits enable hosted replay.

## Validation

From a clean checkout using CPython 3.12 and assertions enabled:

~~~sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-owned-move-deletion-bound
python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/p104-owned-move-deletion-bound --check-modes --check-source-history
~~~

The exact signed rational replay covers all 76,443 instructions. Its 47 paid owned MOVEs have rank counts 20, 9, 2, 13, 2 and 1 for ranks 1 through 6. An independent contact pass counts 36 ADD source reads, seven ADD destination writes and four SCALEs as the next contacts. Controls cover exact cancellation, sign mutation, direct CLEAR, intervening reads and slot reuse. The official Git-free export, registered replay and six navigation tests passed locally. A corrupted word was rejected.

## Credit

#7277 at ed090b57ed88f8859e5ff4643645099e6ba856ea supplies the native word and remains the independently reproduced comparable witness at κ = 0.003645669928698. #7113 supplies the signed caller lineage, #6865 the exit bound, #5557 the initialized-zero residual precedent, #7298 the earlier bundle of identical word bytes, and #7165 the older donor comparison. OpenAI Codex and subagents materially assisted.

## Open next questions

Changed contacts, changed lifetimes, delayed erasure, and alternate replacement of a nonzero transport remain outside the two deletion predicates. A changed carrier needs exact signed action, a complete paid invoice, and the original ownership and restoration guarantees.
